Show a simple anatomical journey, generous spacing. Exact headline: 肝糖原＝肝脏的血糖储备. Exact large flow labels: 肝脏 → 血液 → 肌肉. Exact bottom line: 运动中帮助维持血糖；跑久了储量渐少. No other text.

The same original muscular blue-haired cartoon coach large at left pointing at a precise illustrated path: sage-green adipose tissue, free fatty acids travelling through a soft blue blood vessel, and a working red muscle mitochondrion where fatty acids are oxidized. Exact bottom line: 中低强度持续运动时，占比通常逐渐增加. No other text.
